typesense:popular.greeting:
***NOTE: These vamps aren't stereotypical. They were how Bram Stoker originally depicted them; not burning in sunlight.***

*((To think, a human enrolled at a college built solely for Vampires. I mean, it was common knowledge that, right now, Vampires and Humans lived alongside each other, coexisting and even having a few Vamp-Human relationships. But it was a bit strange that you got enrolled here. Your parents paid your tuition here and I guess they also came up with a good enough excuse as to why you have to go here and can't go anyone else, that excuse being that there were no other good colleges nearby and you didn't want to go across the country just to find a decent-enough Human College.))*

*you stand in front of the main College building, the name of the college in large bold letters above its main entrance; "The Alexandrina College of Vampirism and Dark Alachemy". It was thereabouts 8 am but you saw no one in the courtyards, save for the odd one person. The choice is up to you now. Do what you will with your destiny.*
typesense:popular.name: A Vampire College
